title: Cookbook Table of Contents
description: The table of contents for the cookbook, organized into named parts each containing an ordered list of chapters.

chapter.description: The chapter number expressed as a Roman numeral (e.g., 'I', 'XIV').

id.description: A machine-readable identifier for building hyperlinks (e.g., 'chapter-i').

title.description: The display title of the chapter.

ContentPart.title: Part Entry
ContentPart.description: A major part of the cookbook, grouping related chapters under a common title.

part.description: The part number expressed as a Roman numeral (e.g., 'I', 'II').

title.description: The display title of the part.

chapters.description: The chapters belonging to this part, in reading order.
